_comment: Gzipped byte budgets for dist/assets/js, enforced by scripts/ci/check-bundle-budget.mjs. eagerJs is what the browser downloads before the entry can run (the entry chunk plus its static import closure). Measured at 431.7 kB on 2026-09-08 and lowered from 454000 to 280000 on 2026-09-09 (US-844), when the Sentry SDK moved behind a dynamic import: 395.6 kB -> 266.6 kB gz, and vendor-sentry left the closure entirely. A budget left above a win is a ceiling, not a ratchet. Measured values and the reasoning are in .ci/bundle-budget.md. Regenerate with --update only for a deliberate, explained change. vendor-supabase was raised from 2932 to 42000 on 2026-09-06: see .ci/bundle-budget.md, the 0.9 kB measurement behind the old number is not reproducible.
